subject: words
title: Ew and ue: new, blue
about: Two spellings that say oo, as in new and blue (in a few words, like few and rescue, there is a little y in front: yoo, the long u sound). CKLA Grade 1 teaches only oo for this sound (Unit 3) and leaves ew and ue to Grade 2, so this is the last step-ahead level, for the end of the year; NC RF.1.4.c (vowel teams for long vowel sounds).
tip: Both teams say oo like moon; if it sounds odd, add a little y in front (few, cue).
